::: {#hero-heading}
<div class="h1">Benvinguda/Welcome!</div>
Hi, I'm Núria, a bioinformatician based in Barcelona with a passion for making sense of large-scale genomic data.

I work at IDIBELL as part of the [Oncology Data Analytics Program (ODAP)](https://www.idibell.cat), where I develop reproducible computational pipelines and apply machine learning to uncover cancer biomarkers. My research spans the full multi-omics spectrum, from whole-genome sequencing and RNA-seq to DNA methylation and microbiome data.

Currently, I'm particularly excited about two projects: mapping the gut microbiome of the Catalan population and building polygenic risk score models for multi-cancer prediction. Learn more in [publications](/publications.qmd).

Curious about my work or just want to say hello? [Send me a message!](mailto:nmoragas@live.com)!
:::

## About me

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-6 #about-me-1}
**Biologist turned bioinformatician, passionate about turning complex genomic data into meaningful biological insights.**

I build reproducible pipelines in [R](https://www.r-project.org/) and [Python](https://www.python.org/) for large-scale NGS data — from WGS and RNA-seq to DNA methylation and microbiome — and apply machine learning to discover cancer biomarkers. I work in high-performance computing environments and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of clinicians, researchers, and data scientists.

<ul class="fa-ul">
  <li><span class="fa-li"><i class="fa-solid fa-briefcase"></i></span>Bioinformatics Data Scientist ∙ IDIBELL, ODAP ∙ 2022–Present</li>
  <li><span class="fa-li"><i class="fa-solid fa-flask"></i></span>Visiting Researcher ∙ Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory ∙ 2019</li>
</ul>
:::

::: {.g-col-6 #about-me-2}
Prior to joining IDIBELL, I spent five years at IDIBAPS investigating transcriptional mechanisms in breast cancer progression, developing RNA-seq pipelines and integrating experimental and computational data to identify regulatory biomarkers. My background combines wet lab expertise with advanced computational skills.
